            percent.percent_to_fraction("101%")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            percent.percent_to_fraction("200%")

            percent.percent_to_fraction("-0%")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            percent.percent_to_fraction("+50%")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            percent.percent_to_fraction("-50%")
